tooltips.sketch: Draw a 2D sketch on a plane
tooltips.exitSketch: Keep the sketch and return to the part
tooltips.exportStep: Export as STEP for other CAD systems
tooltips.importDxf: Add the lines, circles and arcs of a DXF file to the sketch
tooltips.exportDxf: Save the sketch as DXF, e.g. for laser cutting (without construction geometry)
tooltips.variables: Named values and equations: use them in dimensions and feature parameters
tooltips.extrude: Extrude the closed outlines of a sketch, or cut them out of the body
tooltips.revolve: Revolve the closed outlines of a sketch around a line of the sketch, or cut them out of the body
tooltips.plane: Create a reference plane: offset, at an angle, through points or between two planes
tooltips.axis: Create a reference axis: along an edge or a cylinder, where two planes meet or through two points
tooltips.point: Create a reference point: by coordinates, at a center or where an axis meets a plane
tooltips.hole: Drill holes for metric screws at the points of a sketch: clearance, counterbore, countersink or tapped
tooltips.pattern: Copy features in a row along a direction
tooltips.shell: Hollow the part out to thin walls, open at the faces you pick
tooltips.material: Choose the material (density) and the color of the part
tooltips.massProperties: Show mass, center of mass and moments of inertia of the part
tooltips.measure: Measure distances, angles, lengths and areas of faces, edges and vertices
tooltips.exportThreeMf: Export as 3MF for 3D printing, with material and color
tooltips.importStep: Import a STEP file as a body
tooltips.csys: Create a coordinate system: at a position, or at a point with its axes along edges, axes or plane normals
tooltips.draft: Tilt faces by an angle about a neutral plane, for molding and casting
tooltips.sweep: Sweep the closed outlines of a sketch along the curves of another sketch
tooltips.loft: Make a solid through the outlines of several sketches, in order
tooltips.rib: Add a wall from the open curves of a sketch to the body, such as a gusset in a corner
tooltips.thread: Cut a modeled ISO metric thread into a bolt or a hole
tooltips.configurations: Variants of the part: switch between them and edit their variables in a design table
tooltips.helix: Create a helix around the circle of a sketch, as the path of a spring or a coil
tooltips.projectedCurve: Project the curves of a sketch onto faces, or make a 3D curve where the curves of two sketches meet
tooltips.compositeCurve: Join edges, sketch curves and other curves into one curve, as the path of a sweep

sketchToolTips.centerline: Draw construction lines, e.g. symmetry axes (L)
sketchToolTips.centerRectangle: Rectangle from its center and a corner (R)
sketchToolTips.threePointRectangle: Rectangle at any angle: one side from two points, then the width (R)
sketchToolTips.circle: Circle from its center and a point on it (C)
sketchToolTips.centerArc: Arc from its center, start and end point (A)
sketchToolTips.threePointArc: Arc through start, end and a third point (A)
sketchToolTips.spline: Smooth curve through the points you click (S)
sketchToolTips.construction: Turn the selected geometry into construction geometry or back
sketchToolTips.dimension: Dimension lengths, distances, angles and radii; the type follows from the selection (D)
sketchToolTips.ellipse: Ellipse from its center, the end of one axis and the width (C)
sketchToolTips.tangentArc: Arc that continues a line or arc tangentially from its end point (A)
sketchToolTips.slot: Straight slot from the two arc centers and the width
sketchToolTips.polygon: Regular polygon from the center and a corner
sketchToolTips.sketchFillet: Round the corner where two lines meet
sketchToolTips.sketchChamfer: Bevel the corner where two lines meet
sketchToolTips.trim: Remove the piece of a curve between its crossings (T)
sketchToolTips.extend: Lengthen a line or arc up to the next curve (T)
sketchToolTips.convert: Convert edges of the model into sketch geometry on the sketch plane

tree.title: Feature tree
tree.empty: Start with a sketch, a box or a cylinder from the command bar.
tree.rollbackHint: Drag the bar (or use the arrow keys) to roll the part back. Features below it are not built; new features go in above it.

moveRefused.parent: {{name}} cannot move above {{other}}: it builds on it.
moveRefused.child: {{name}} cannot move below {{other}}: {{other}} builds on it.
moveRefused.variables: The variables stay at the top of the tree.

panel.edgesHint: Click edges in the 3D view, or a face to take all of its edges (also ones it gets later). Click again to deselect.
panel.edgesMissing_one: {{count}} edge no longer exists. Its place is marked in the 3D view.
panel.edgesMissing_other: {{count}} edges no longer exist. Their places are marked in the 3D view.
panel.firstMustAdd: The first feature must add material.
panel.extrudeHint: Every closed outline of the sketch is extruded; outlines inside others become holes. Normal goes along the normal of the sketch plane, Mid-plane goes half the depth each way. Through all goes past the whole body, also when it changes later.
panel.revolveHint: Every closed outline of the sketch is revolved around the axis, a line of the same sketch (usually a centerline). The outlines must stay on one side of it; they may touch it.
panel.endNextHint: Adding goes until the outline meets the body; cutting goes through the first material each outline meets (a wall, not the whole part).
panel.thinHint: Walls along every curve of the sketch, open curves too: one side is outside a closed outline (and for open curves the side the preview shows), both sides puts half the thickness on each. Lines and arcs meet in sharp corners.

errors.no-body: There is no body to modify yet.
errors.edge-missing: A selected edge no longer exists: an earlier change removed it. Edit the feature and select the edges again.
errors.face-missing: The face this sketch was drawn on no longer exists. The sketch stays where the face was.
errors.empty-result: The operation removed the whole body.
errors.first-must-add: The first feature must add material.
errors.sketch-missing: The sketch of this feature is missing or suppressed. Edit the feature and choose a sketch.
errors.profile-empty: The sketch has no closed outline. Close its outlines, turn on Thin feature for walls along open curves, or choose another sketch.
errors.profile-crossing: Curves of the sketch cross each other near ({{detail}}) mm. Trim them so the outlines are clear.
errors.operation-failed: The geometry kernel could not build this feature ({{detail}}).
errors.axis-missing: The axis of this revolution is missing. Edit the feature and choose a line of the sketch as the axis.
errors.axis-not-in-plane: The axis must lie in the plane of the sketch. Choose an axis in that plane, or a line of the sketch.
errors.hole-no-points: The sketch has no points for holes. Add points that are not ends or centers of curves.
errors.hole-invalid: The dimensions of the hole do not fit together: a counterbore or countersink must be wider than the hole and less deep, a thread no deeper than the hole.
errors.pattern-empty: Choose the features to copy: click them in the feature tree or one of their faces in the 3D view.
errors.pattern-seed-missing: A feature to copy is missing or suppressed. Edit the feature and choose the features again.
errors.pattern-unsupported: Only features that add or cut material can be copied: extrusions, revolutions, sweeps, lofts, holes, boxes, cylinders, and patterns and mirror images of them.
errors.shell-face-missing: The faces to open no longer exist: an earlier change removed them. Edit the shell and pick the faces again.
errors.end-behind: The end lies behind the sketch in this direction. Choose the other direction or another end.
errors.end-parallel: The extrusion runs along this plane and never reaches it. Choose a plane at an angle to the extrusion.
errors.end-missed: The body or surface does not stop the whole outline: part of it would go on without end. Move the outline or choose another end.
errors.thin-empty: The sketch has no curves to put walls along.
errors.thin-unsupported: Walls along ellipses and splines are not possible yet ({{detail}}). Use lines and arcs, or turn the thin feature off.
errors.thin-branching: More than two curves meet at ({{detail}}) mm: walls need chains of curves without branches.
errors.thin-too-thick: The walls are too thick for the curves: an arc or a short line would vanish inside them. Make the walls thinner or put them on the other side.
errors.round-faces: Pick the faces of the round in order ({{detail}} picked).
errors.round-face-missing: Face {{detail}} of the full round no longer exists: an earlier change removed it. Edit the fillet and pick it again.
errors.round-sides: The side faces of a full round must be parallel planes on opposite sides of the material.
errors.round-center: The center face must lie between the two side faces.
errors.round-planes: A face fillet needs two planar faces that meet at a corner (not parallel ones).
errors.round-radius: The radius is too large: the round would start beyond the faces. Make it smaller.
errors.profile-crosses-axis: Outlines of the sketch lie on both sides of the axis. Keep them on one side; they may touch it.
errors.plane-missing: The reference plane this sketch was drawn on no longer exists. The sketch stays where the plane was.
errors.reference-missing: Reference {{detail}} of this feature is missing: it was not chosen yet, or an earlier change removed it. Edit the feature and choose it.
errors.reference-kind: Reference {{detail}} does not fit: choose a plane, an axis or a point, as its field asks for.
errors.reference-parallel: The references are parallel, so they do not meet. Choose references that cross each other.
errors.reference-not-parallel: The axis must lie parallel to the plane: the new plane turns around it.
errors.reference-collinear: The points lie on one line or on each other, so they do not define the plane or axis.
errors.import-no-solid: The STEP file contains no solid body (only surfaces or wireframes).
errors.draft-face: Face {{detail}} cannot be drafted: it must run along the pull direction (not across it).
errors.draft-face-missing: {{detail}} of the faces to draft no longer exist: an earlier change removed them. Edit the draft and pick them again.
errors.path-empty: The path sketch has no curves.
errors.path-branching: The path branches at ({{detail}}) mm: it must be one chain of curves.
errors.path-gaps: The curves of the path do not form one connected chain. Close the gaps, or put the other curves into another sketch.
errors.sweep-failed: The profile cannot follow the path: it may cross itself where the path bends tighter than the profile is wide.
errors.loft-sections: A loft needs at least two profiles.
errors.loft-profile: Profile {{detail}} must be one closed outline without holes.
errors.loft-failed: The profiles could not be joined. Check that they lie one after the other and are not twisted against each other.
errors.rib-curves: A rib within its sketch plane follows lines only; {{detail}} is another curve.
errors.thread-face: Pick the cylindrical face of a bolt or a hole for the thread.
errors.thread-size: Pitch and length of the thread must be above 0.
errors.helix-circle: The sketch of the helix needs a circle: the helix winds around its center with its radius.
errors.sweep-holes: Along a helix, the profile takes outlines without holes.
errors.curve-empty: The curve has nothing to project or join: choose a sketch with curves, or pick edges or add sketches and curves.
errors.curve-missed: The curves do not land on the chosen faces, or the curves of the two sketches do not meet. Check the faces and the side.
errors.curve-faces: Pick the faces the curves are projected onto.
errors.curve-edge-missing: {{detail}} edge(s) of the curve no longer exist: an earlier change removed them. Edit the curve and pick the edges again.
errors.pattern-too-many: The pattern would make {{detail}} copies; at most 10,000 are possible. Reduce the counts.

warnings.edge-missing_other: {{count}} selected edges no longer exist and are left out. Edit the feature to remove them or pick other edges.
warnings.shell-face-missing_one: {{count}} face to open no longer exists and is left out. Edit the shell to pick another face.
warnings.shell-face-missing_other: {{count}} faces to open no longer exist and are left out. Edit the shell to pick other faces.

warnings.draft-face-missing_other: {{count}} faces to draft no longer exist and are left out. Edit the draft to pick other faces.

sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.choosePlaneHint: Click a plane or a planar face of the part in the view, a plane in the feature tree, or choose one here.
sketch.exitHint: ✓ keeps the sketch, ✕ discards your changes. Undo and redo work step by step inside the sketch.

toolHints.select: Drag geometry to move it, click to select. Choose a drawing tool in the Sketch tab.
toolHints.line: Click the start point, then each next point. Clicking the start point closes the chain; Esc or a second click ends it.
toolHints.centerline: Like lines; the result is construction geometry (dashed) that does not become part of the profile.
toolHints.cornerRectangle: Click one corner, then the opposite corner (or drag).
toolHints.centerRectangle: Click the center, then a corner (or drag).
toolHints.threePointRectangle: Click both ends of one side, then move sideways to set the width and click. The sides stay perpendicular.
toolHints.parallelogram: Click both ends of one side, then the third corner. Opposite sides stay parallel.
toolHints.circle: Click the center, then a point on the circle (or drag).
toolHints.centerArc: Click the center, then the start point; move in the direction of the arc and click the end point.
toolHints.threePointArc: Click the start point and the end point, then a point the arc passes through.
toolHints.point: Click to place points; on a line or circle they stay on it.
toolHints.spline: Click the points the curve passes through; each one is a sketch point that can be dimensioned and related. Esc or a second click on the last point ends the spline.
toolHints.snapping: Points snap to end points, midpoints and curves and align with other points (dashed lines); the matching relations are added automatically. Esc leaves the tool.
toolHints.dimension: Click a line, circle or arc for its length or size, or two entities – points, lines, circles (at their centers), the origin or an edge of the part – for the distance or angle between them. Move the value to where it belongs and click. Then type the value and press Enter. An edge of the part becomes fixed construction geometry of the sketch.
toolHints.threePointCircle: Click three points the circle passes through.
toolHints.ellipse: Click the center, then the end of one axis; move sideways to set the other axis and click. Dimension the axes from the center to the two axis points.
toolHints.tangentArc: Click the end point of a line or arc, then where the arc should end. The arc leaves the line or arc tangentially.
toolHints.slot: Click the centers of both ends, then move sideways to set the width and click.
toolHints.polygon: Click the center, then a corner. All sides stay equal; the corners lie on a construction circle.
toolHints.sketchFillet: Set the radius, then click corners where two lines meet. The lines are shortened and joined by a tangent arc with a radius dimension.
toolHints.sketchChamfer: Set the distance, then click corners where two lines meet. Both lines are shortened by the distance and joined by a line.
toolHints.trim: Move over a curve: the piece up to the neighboring crossings turns red; click to remove it. A curve that nothing crosses is removed completely.
toolHints.extend: Move near the end of a line or arc: a dashed preview shows how far it grows; click to extend it up to the next curve.
toolHints.convert: Click edges of the model: they are projected onto the sketch plane and become fixed sketch geometry (lines, circles, arcs, ellipses or splines). Touching edges stay connected.

sketch.noRelations: The selected geometry has no relations yet.

messages.redundantRelation: This relation already follows from the existing relations and dimensions, so it would over-define the sketch.
messages.conflictingRelation: This relation contradicts the existing relations and dimensions.
messages.drivenDimension: This dimension would over-define the sketch, so it was added as a reference dimension that only shows the value.
messages.dimensionNotApplied: The sketch cannot be solved with this value; the dimension keeps its previous value.
messages.invalidDimension: Enter a length greater than 0, or an angle between 0 and 180 degrees.
messages.drivenNotEditable: Reference dimensions show the measured value and cannot be changed.
messages.cornerNotACorner: Click a corner where exactly two lines meet.
messages.cornerTooLarge: The radius or distance is too large for the lines at this corner.
messages.cornerStraight: The two lines continue each other in a straight line; there is no corner.
messages.trimNotACurve: Click on a line, circle, arc, ellipse or spline.
messages.trimEllipse: An ellipse that other curves cross cannot be cut into pieces; trim the other curves, or delete the ellipse.
messages.extendNoTarget: There is no curve to extend to in this direction.
messages.extendConnected: This end is connected to other geometry and cannot be extended.
messages.extendConstrained: Relations or dimensions hold this end in place; delete them to extend it.
messages.transformNoAxis: Select a line as mirror axis as well: a construction line, or select the axis last.
messages.moveBlocked: The selection cannot move there: relations or dimensions hold it in place.
messages.scaleBlocked: The selection cannot be scaled: relations or dimensions to other geometry hold its size.
messages.offsetTooLarge: The distance is too large for the selected curves.
messages.convertNothing: This edge has no extent on the sketch plane (it is perpendicular to it).
messages.convertMissed: Click an edge of the model.
messages.convertRepeated: This edge is already in the sketch.

sketch.dimensionHint: Double-click a dimension to change its value, drag it to move the value. Delete removes it.
sketch.relationHint: Hovering a symbol highlights the geometry it relates. Delete removes the selected relations.

statusHint.under: Blue geometry can still move. Add relations and dimensions until everything is dark.
statusHint.full: Every point and curve is determined by relations and dimensions.
statusHint.over: Relations or dimensions contradict each other; the affected geometry is red. Delete one of the conflicting entries below.

transform.title: Copy and move
transform.mirrorHint: Mirrors the selection about the selected construction line (or the line selected last). Mirrored points stay symmetric.
transform.offsetHint: Closed outlines and circles grow outwards (inwards with "Other side"); open chains move to the left of their direction. Lines stay parallel, arcs keep their centers, and the first line gets the distance as a dimension.
transform.scaleHint: Dimensions within the selection scale along.

variables.hint: Named values for the whole part. Type a name in a dimension or a parameter (for example "width / 2") and it follows the variable; an expression may use other variables.
variables.name: Name

variables.sketchFailed_other: {{count}} sketches could not follow the new values and kept their previous state.

problems.name: Names start with a letter and use letters, digits and _ (not units or functions such as mm or sin).

errors.syntax: This is not a valid value or equation.

copy.circularHint: Count includes the original. 360° spreads them evenly all round; a smaller angle puts the last copy at its end.

massProperties.tensor: Inertia tensor at the center of mass

recovery.title: Recover unsaved work
recovery.message: ParaWerk was not closed properly last time. These documents had unsaved changes:
recovery.restored: {{name}} was restored. Save it to keep it.
recovery.failed: The copy could not be restored: {{message}}
recovery.hint: Copies you do not restore or discard now are offered again at the next start.

import.hint: The solids of the STEP file become a body of their own (or are cut out of the part). The file is kept in the part: changes to it later do not reach the part; replace it here.
import.tooLarge: the file is larger than 64 MB
import.notStep: this is not a STEP file (ISO 10303-21)

chamfer.flip: Measure distance 1 on the other face

fillet.roundHint: Click a side face, the face between the sides and the other side face. The face in the middle becomes half a cylinder touching all three; the side faces must be parallel planes (a rib, the end of a tab).
fillet.facesHint: Click two planar faces that meet at a corner. The round of the radius runs between them, also where they share no edge: faces between them (a chamfer, a step) are rounded over, and an inner corner is filled.
fillet.variableHint: The radius changes evenly along each edge, from its start to its end. The start is the end with the smaller coordinates (left, front, bottom); Swap start and end turns that round.

draft.hint: Pick the neutral plane, then the faces to tilt (click again to take one out). The faces turn about the line where they cross the neutral plane, so the part gets narrower along the pull direction, the normal of the plane.

sweep.hint: The outlines are swept as they lie, so draw them across the start of the path. The path is one chain of lines, arcs, ellipses or splines in another sketch, open or closed, or a helix; it runs from its end nearer to the outlines. Along a helix, draw the outlines in a plane through its axis, at its start point.

loft.hint: Each sketch gives one closed outline (without holes). The solid goes through them in the order of the list, usually on parallel planes one above the other.

rib.hint: Draw open lines where the rib should end, for example across the corner between a wall and a floor. Within the sketch plane the rib fills the space between the lines and the body, as thick as the thickness across the plane; normal to the sketch it grows from the curves down to the body. It grows towards the material on its own.

thread.pickCylinder: Click the cylindrical face of a bolt or a hole
thread.hint: The thread is modeled: its groove is cut into the part, as 3D printing needs (for drilling and tapping, a hole with a cosmetic thread is lighter). A bolt keeps its diameter as the outside of the thread; a hole should be drilled with the tap drill. The thread starts at one end of the face, runs out of it there and goes the length into the face, at most to its other end. It takes a second or two to compute.

configurations.title: Configurations
configurations.hint: Each configuration remembers the values of the part's variables and which features are suppressed. The marked one is shown; changes to the part belong to it. The table lists the variables of all configurations; change a cell to change a configuration.
configurations.name: Name
configurations.none: The part has one configuration. Add one to make variants of it – it starts as a copy of the part as it is now.
configurations.noVariables: The part has no variables yet: add them under Features → Variables to give configurations different dimensions.
configurations.nameTaken: Another configuration has that name already.

helix.reverse: Wind to the other side of the sketch
helix.hint: The helix winds around the first circle of the sketch, with its radius, starting on the circle at the start angle (from the sketch X axis). Sweep a profile along it for a spring or a coil: draw the profile in a plane through the axis of the helix, at its start point.

curve.pickFaces: Click the faces in the 3D view

sides.both: On both sides of the sketch

curve.hintFaces: The curves of the sketch (not construction geometry) are projected along the sketch normal onto the faces you click – on both sides of the sketch, or only on one. A sweep follows the result if it is one piece.
curve.hintSketch: Draw the curve as seen from two directions, in two sketches on planes at an angle: the 3D curve is where the curves meet when each is extended along its sketch normal.
curve.hintComposite: Click edges of the part and add sketches and curves; together they must join end to end into one chain. The result is a path for a sweep.
